notes.title: Only Up: SKIBIDI TOGETHER release date July 12th!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

notes.title: Update 1.01
notes.notes:
We have released an update for the game!

List of changes:


 Furry animation has been fixed.
 Fixed UI in Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Polish.
 Added VHS camera filter in the lobby.


Achievements:

 Added two achievements


In the near future we plan to release a map update and add some interesting mechanics.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44894499/0eb764d9445d886bb5e649f4a9205dbf4ee8b61d.png

We are also working on creating a new level. Write in the comments what you would like to see at the new location.

Have a nice game!
